source.title: One Last Drop
source.description:
The bait is ready, now we must lay the trap. I've modified the talisman per Fahrad's instructions. All that's left is for you to deliver it as you have the other artifacts before.

Go to the cabin near Pyrewood Village, and put this modified talisman into Caius' dead drop.

What follows is out of our hands, for now.
source.objective: Take the Modified Talisman to Caius' dead drop near Pyrewood Village.
source.completion: <You place the Modified Talisman into the chest.>
